title: Signal processing for slug flow analysis: MATLAB algorithm
author: Soto-Cortes, Pereyra, et al.

steps.title: Collect sensor time-series data
steps.instruction: Obtain voltage or instantaneous liquid‑holdup time‑series from the data‑acquisition station, which has two sensors per station separated by a known distance; label each sensor vector as NCap_i (i = sensor number).

steps.title: Save data and record experiment metadata
steps.instruction: For each experimental condition j, store the normalized sensor vectors (sampled at frequency f_s with time step Δt) in a MAT‑file named Experiment_j_Station_i.mat (e.g., Experiment_4_Station_2.mat must contain NCap7 and NCap8). Record the seven variables—experiment trial, superficial liquid velocity, superficial gas velocity, temperature, pipe inclination angle, data‑acquiring time interval, and stations available—in the Excel workbook sheet “MyExperiments”. For a dataset of six experiments with two working stations each, ensure 6 × 2 = 12 MAT files are available.

steps.title: Create MATLAB data folder
steps.instruction: Place BSignalProcessing2020.m in the MATLAB working folder (or another convenient directory). Create a data folder and copy all Experiment_j_Station_i.mat files and the Excel file(s) into it. Only one Excel file is required unless results are to be saved in separate files.
